pages.text: $(bold)Ship Core Modifier$()$(br2)A workbench for tuning your ship core's slot layout.$(br2)It adjusts:$(br)• Weapon slot count (2~8)$(br)• Enhancement slot count (1~6)$(br2)More slots are not always better — every configuration has trade-offs.

$(bold)Usage:$()$(br)1. Craft and place the Ship Core Modifier$(br)2. Right-click to open the interface$(br)3. Insert your ship core$(br)4. Choose weapon/enhancement slot counts within the allowed range$(br)5. Confirm the modification$(br2)$(bold)Tip:$() Plan the layout before a sortie — slots are fixed once the core is modified.
